newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar holds above lows, eyes weaker NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar holds above lows, eyes weaker NY.

text.p: London white sugar futures drifted lower in modest Monday turnover following the light sell-off in New York but managed to hold off earlier lows as July raws support held intact.
Broker interest in the August/October white sugar spread ensured that the the nearby differential held steady at around the $9.00 mark, with crossed trades boosting the overall volume.
But traders said most attention would be concentrated on the May expiry in New York and the long position of speculators in the two remaining sessions.
But London' trading pattern was much the same as the morning as the only four contracts traded edged slightly lower and ranges stayed tight at under $2.00.
At 1535 GMT nearby positions were in mid-range. August was down $1.00 at $313.90 and October down $1.10 at $305.20. Others were marginally lower.
Volume was unimpressive at 1,051 lots and dominated by the two front contracts.
The Paris market broadly kept pace with London and also headed lower in a light volume of 259 lots.
August was down $1.30 at $313.50 and October down 80 cents at $305.70.
